about: Prometheus' text format and OpenMetrics' read into series alike in every language. Each case is ingested with its labels, at for a sample the text gives no time and keep, into a store whose clock is within keep of at; every case's names are its own, so that one store takes them all. series is what the store then holds of each name, each sample [unix ms, value as the text format spells it], compared bit for bit, NaN as the quiet NaN 0x7ff8000000000000; error is the kind a case is refused with and words its message holds, and a refused text writes nothing.

cases.name: a counter and a gauge with their labels, HELP read past
cases.text:
# HELP node_cpu_seconds_total Seconds the CPUs spent in each mode.
# TYPE node_cpu_seconds_total counter
node_cpu_seconds_total{cpu="0",mode="idle"} 1.23456789e+06
node_cpu_seconds_total{cpu="0",mode="user"} 4567.89
# HELP node_load1 1m load average.
# TYPE node_load1 gauge
node_load1 0.42

cases.name: a histogram's buckets as histogram with their le, its sum and count as counters
cases.text:
# HELP http_request_duration_seconds A histogram of the request duration.
# TYPE http_request_duration_seconds histogram
http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{le="0.1"} 240
http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{le="0.5"} 310
http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{le="+Inf"} 320
http_request_duration_seconds_sum 41.7
http_request_duration_seconds_count 320

cases.name: a summary: a gauge per quantile, its sum and count as counters
cases.text:
# TYPE rpc_duration_seconds summary
rpc_duration_seconds{quantile="0.5"} 0.012
rpc_duration_seconds{quantile="0.99"} 0.27
rpc_duration_seconds_sum 1520.5
rpc_duration_seconds_count 120000

cases.name: untyped and a sample without a type are gauges
a time in Prometheus' text is milliseconds
OpenMetrics: seconds, _total, _created left out, exemplars, info, stateset, gaugehistogram and unknown
cases.text:
# TYPE om_requests counter
# HELP om_requests Requests served.
om_requests_total{path="/"} 1027 1789999990.5 # {trace_id="KOO5S4vxi0o"} 1 1789999990.1
om_requests_created{path="/"} 1789990000.0
# TYPE om_latency_seconds histogram
# UNIT om_latency_seconds seconds
om_latency_seconds_bucket{le="1.0"} 7 # {trace_id="oHg5SJYRHA0"} 0.67
om_latency_seconds_bucket{le="+Inf"} 9
om_latency_seconds_sum 4.5
om_latency_seconds_count 9
om_latency_seconds_created 1789990000.0
# TYPE om_rpc_seconds summary
om_rpc_seconds{quantile="0.9"} 0.2
om_rpc_seconds_sum 3.5
om_rpc_seconds_count 17
om_rpc_seconds_created 1789990000.0
# TYPE om_build info
om_build_info{version="1.2.3"} 1
# TYPE om_feature stateset
om_feature{om_feature="a"} 1
om_feature{om_feature="b"} 0
# TYPE om_queue gaugehistogram
om_queue_bucket{le="10.0"} 3
om_queue_bucket{le="+Inf"} 5
om_queue_gcount 5
om_queue_gsum 21
# TYPE om_mystery unknown
om_mystery 3.5
# EOF

cases.name: a _created gauge of Prometheus' text is a gauge of its own
cases.text:
# TYPE py_jobs_total counter
py_jobs_total 3
# TYPE py_jobs_created gauge
py_jobs_created 1.789e+09

cases.name: a label's escapes read, any other backslash kept
NaN, the infinities, -0 and the edges of a float, bit for bit
cases.text:
# TYPE odd_values gauge
odd_values{case="nan"} NaN
odd_values{case="inf"} +Inf
odd_values{case="-inf"} -Inf
odd_values{case="-0"} -0
odd_values{case="tiny"} 5e-324
odd_values{case="big"} 1.7976931348623157e+308

cases.name: blanks, tabs, CRLF, comments and a trailing comma; an empty label is no label
cases.text:
# a comment that says nothing

#   TYPE   spaced_gauge   gauge
  spaced_gauge { a = "1" , b="" ,}	7

cases.name: the call's labels beside each series' own
a time given twice keeps the later value
Prometheus 3's quoted names and label names, kept as they are, dots and all
a label's value without its closing quote

error.has: metrics: line 2, `e_quote{path="/a} 1`: label path: a value without its closing quote

cases.name: a value that is not a number

error.has: metrics: line 1, `e_value 12,5`: a value "12,5": a number, +Inf, -Inf or NaN

cases.name: a value past the largest float

error.has: metrics: line 1, `e_huge 1e400`: a value "1e400": past the largest float

cases.name: a second # TYPE of one name
cases.text:
# TYPE e_twice gauge
# TYPE e_twice counter

error.has: metrics: line 2, `# TYPE e_twice counter`: a second `# TYPE` of e_twice

cases.name: a # TYPE after its samples

error.has: metrics: line 2, `# TYPE e_late_type counter`: the `# TYPE` of e_late_type after its sample e_late_type

cases.name: a type no format has

error.has: metrics: line 1, `# TYPE e_type countr`: a type "countr"

cases.name: a line after # EOF

error.has: metrics: line 3, `e_after 2`: a line after `# EOF`, which ends the text

cases.name: OpenMetrics' seconds in a text without # EOF

error.has: metrics: line 1, `e_seconds 1 1789999990.5`: a time "1789999990.5": milliseconds, an integer

cases.name: a histogram's sample named as the histogram

error.has: metrics: line 2, `e_hist 3`: e_hist is a histogram, whose samples are e_hist_bucket, e_hist_sum and e_hist_count

cases.name: a label given twice
a label the call gives too

error.has: metrics: line 1, `e_instance{instance="db-1"} 1`: label instance, which the call gives every series

cases.name: a label the store keeps for its own, refused by the store naming the series

error.has: metrics e_own{__secret="x"}: label "__secret": a name beginning with __ is the store's own

cases.name: a name that begins with a digit

error.has: metrics: line 1, `9lives 1`: a sample's line begins with its metric's name

cases.name: a quoted name without its closing quote

error.has: metrics: line 1, `{"e.open 1`: a quoted name: a value without its closing quote

cases.name: a sample of two names, one before its braces and one quoted in them

error.has: metrics: line 1, `e_two{"e.two"} 1`: a sample of two names, e_two and "e.two"

cases.name: an empty quoted name

error.has: metrics: line 1, `{""} 1`: a quoted name of no character

cases.name: an empty quoted label name

error.has: metrics: line 1, `{"e.empty", ""="v"} 1`: a quoted name of no character
